DAWN · BELL SQUARE
The breakfast masquerade
Choose elsewhere

The scar of bellmarked tightens as you arrive. Mina recognizes you and has shifted the market onto safer ground. The stalls have become a silent dance. Inspector Brann wears a fox mask and Mina carries a lantern filled with yesterday’s red petals.

You know the way here. Spend 1 Momentum to make this visit without moving the clock. One extra visit per loop; every new choice stays yours.
